summary: tax_for now returns None instead of 0 for unknown regions. The existing callers in the shop package are not updated to handle None.

findings.title: None return breaks order_total and tax_line callers
findings.problem: tax_for now returns None for an unknown region. order_total in shop/checkout.py adds that result to an int, and tax_line in shop/receipt.py divides it by 100.
findings.consequence: Checkout and receipt printing raise TypeError for every order from an unknown region. Before this change, those orders went through with zero tax.
findings.fix: Update order_total and tax_line to handle a None result. Otherwise, keep returning 0 for unknown regions.

findings.title: No test covers the unknown region branch
findings.problem: The repository has no test for tax_for or its callers. Nothing exercises the new branch that returns None.
findings.consequence: A test would have caught the TypeError in the callers before this push.
findings.fix: Add tests for tax_for, order_total and tax_line with an unknown region.
